title: Georgia launches chatbot to help residents navigate state services
summary: Georgia’s latest digital government initiative aims to reduce call center demand and help residents more easily find official information.

title: Terminating E-Rate would cost US economy over $4B annually, study says
summary: The study found that for every $1 cut from the E-Rate program, the U.S. GDP would be reduced by about $1.60.

title: Minnesota braces for Trump administration cuts to state Medicaid funding due to fraud, demands transparency on federal data analytics tools
summary: The state Medicaid office is asking federal officials to disclose the technology involved in their data analytics to determine whether it should take action against individuals or providers.

title: With potentially historic El Niño looming, California reopens State Operations Center with new disaster intelligence satellite capability
summary: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has forecasted a 75% chance that this year’s El Niño will become a historic event,  increasing the risk of high tide flooding in parts of the U.S.

title: NASCIO announces members of 2026-2027 executive leadership team
summary: Utah CIO Alan Fuller has been promoted from the organization’s vice president to president for the coming year.

title: Vermont launches online tool that lets residents test their internet speeds
summary: The VT Speed Check tool also lets residents view broadband coverage across the state and learn how to fix some internet connection problems.

title: Massachusetts man sentenced to two years in federal prison for multi-state SNAP and pandemic unemployment assistance fraud
summary: The case shows how state benefits agencies are struggling to navigate balancing fraud detection with ensuring legitimate recipients receive the assistance they need.

title: Lawmakers introduce Ban Flock Act to block federal funding for state, local governments that use ALPRS
summary: The Ban Flock Act would also allow Americans to sue the federal government for violation of their rights through the use of ALPRs.

title: How Vermont is leveraging AI across government, one ‘power tool’ at a time
summary: Josiah Raiche, Vermont’s chief data and AI officer, told StateScoop that rather than allowing AI to replace state employees, his strategy aims to free them from “drudgery.”

title: Maine expands digital access to public records
summary: The Pine Tree State’s new Open Access platform puts more than 100,000 digitized government and historical records online, with plans to expand the collection as the state continues its long-term digitization effort.
